title: OrchardWay outbound tactic sketch
content:
Purpose:
Quick working sketch for OrchardWay (regional grocery chain ~120 stores). Goal: convert to a 6-week pilot for in-store assistant / cashier augmentation using a hosted + dedicated fallback model. Keep this messy — capture hypotheses and sequence drafts.

Why OrchardWay? (hypothesis)
- Modern tech stack, small central data team (3 engs) but high ops focus.
- Public-facing mobile app with 300k MAU; loyalty program + receipts data; opportunity to reduce call center load and speed checkout queries.
- Likely procurement cycle: small PO + security evaluation; decision-maker = Head of Digital (Maya Chen) + CTO (Rajiv Singh).

Account context / background notes:
- Founded 2009, HQ in PDX, stores in PNW. Investors: regionals. Tried vendor X for personalization in 2022, turned into a data integration mess.
- Tech: React Native app, Postgres + Redshift, SSO via Okta. Hosting: AWS (us-west-2).
- Security posture: wants data residency (US), SOC 2 considered nice-to-have, KMS/HSM integration may be asked for.
- Already using a remote ML vendor for receipts OCR (contract expires Q1 2025).

Key stakeholders (map + asks):
- Maya Chen, Head of Digital (primary champion) — cares about conversion, CX metrics. Ask: pilot to show reduced support tickets.
- Rajiv Singh, CTO (technical sponsor) — cares about infra, SLA, data controls. Ask: simple architecture diagram + security one-pager.
- Lauren Park, Dir of Ops (business sponsor) — cares ops efficiency and training friction. Ask: 1 pager on how agents integrate into associate workflows.

Security / compliance pre-emptive notes (what they'll ask):
- Can we run in VPC? yes (Redwood Private), but likely wants to avoid heavy infra lift. Suggested: hosted API with Dedicated capacity + IP allowlist and KMS for keys.
- Data retention: need option to disable conversational logs or hold-only for X days. Add to FAQ.
- PII handling: redact receipts PII; show example prompt patterns + system instructions for redaction.

Pilot proposition (6-week lightweight):
- Week 0: design + data access checklist (Okta SSO, API keys, allowlist).
- Week 1: sandbox endpoint + demo flow (assistant answers product questions, returns structured product lookup callouts).
- Week 2–4: in-store beta w/ 2 pilot stores, cashier + in-app flow. Flag fallback to human.
- Week 5: evaluate metrics + iterate prompts.
- Week 6: decision readout + ops handoff.

Success metrics (what to promise):
- Primary: 20% reduction in average call center handle time for product/price questions within pilot stores.
- Secondary: 10% increase in add-on attach rate via suggested upsells in-app.
- Safety: 0 PII leakage incidents (hard stop) — monitor logs and eval set.

Technical architecture (brief to share):
- Primary: Redwood Hosted API for rapid start (fast onboarding + A/B), streaming responses for better UX.
- Fallback: Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable latency during peak store hours.
- Optional: Private deployment (VPC) if security review requires data plane in customer network.
- Integrations: Okta SSO, Redshift export for receipts, webhook to ticketing (Zendesk).

Draft outbound sequence (cold -> warm nurture)
1) Short cold email (subject): "Quick idea to cut checkout calls for OrchardWay"
   - 1–2 lines: mutual context (PDX retail), value prop (cut calls / speed checkout), ask: 15 min to share a one-page pilot.
   - CTA: propose 15-min intro and offer a short pilot brief.
2) Follow-up 3 days: one concrete stat + mini case (anonymized). Offer 10-min call.
3) LinkedIn touch: short note referencing email + 1-line value prop.
4) Call prep: first call script bullets (below).

First call / discovery script (bullets)
- Opening: 60 seconds intro, say we built inference platform optimized for retail scale (low-latency, predictable cost).
- Pain check: "How often do cashiers escalate product/price questions to managers or call center?"
- Current state: ask about existing AI vendors, retention of logs, and security review pain points.
- Pilot ask: "Would you be open to a 6-week pilot in 2 stores to test A/B UX?"
- Next step: schedule tech sync with Rajiv or lead infra + send one-pager.

Objection handling (common lines + suggested replies)
- "We have vendor X already" -> Reply: "Totally — quick question: what are the top 2 things you wish X did better? If it's latency/cost/operational support we can demo concrete numbers in 15–20 min."
- "Security concerns / data residency" -> Reply: "We can run a private instance in your VPC or use Dedicated capacity with KMS; happy to walk your security team through architecture and supply SOC2 evidence."
- "Too expensive" -> Reply: "Pilot runs are low-risk: we scope to a handful of stores and provide usage estimates up front; Optimize suggestions often cut token cost by 30–50% for conversational retail flows."
- "We don't have infra bandwidth" -> Reply: "We handle model serving + rollout; integration points are webhooks and outbound API calls — minimal infra lift for a sandbox."

Prompt / eval checklist (quick):
- Build representative prompt set from 50 actual cashier transcripts (anonymize).
- Create eval rubric: accuracy, hallucination rate, PII leakage, response latency.
- Baseline: run current vendor vs Redwood-hosted with caching + 8-bit quantized variant.

Open questions / risks (to resolve before pilot):
- How easily can their receipts pipeline push sanitized data to our sandbox? (ask Data Eng lead)
- Licensing / legal: will they insist on on-prem private deployment? possible cost/time impact.
- Who owns success metric definitions internally? We need a single business sponsor.

Next actions / TODO (personal task list)
- [ ] Finalize one-pager + security one-pager (Asha). Target: 2024-12-05.
- [ ] Run quick cost calc for 2-store 6-week pilot (Miguel). Use worst-case token estimate.
- [ ] Draft cold email (Priya to iterate subject lines).
- [ ] Identify 3 anonymized cashier transcripts for prompt set (ask Lauren).
- [ ] Prepare demo appliance: quick conversation flow + failover to human.

Notes-to-self (brain dump):
- Keep pitch concise: ops owners care in minutes saved, CTO cares about SLA and data controls, marketing cares about loyalty upsell numbers.
- Bring an ask: can we get a 15-min intro with Maya + Rajiv? If no Rajiv early, aim for Maya + tech lead.
- Consider offering PO term: free pilot w/ option to convert to discounted committed Dedicated for first 6 months.

Scratchy outreach copy (first draft):
Subject: small pilot idea to cut OrchardWay checkout friction
Hi Maya —
I’m Asha on the Redwood Inference team. We help retail brands reduce checkout friction and inbound support with an inference platform optimized for predictable latency and cost.
Would you be open to a short 6-week pilot in 2 stores to prove a 20% reduction in call-center volume for product/price questions? I can send a one-pager + security brief.
Best,
Asha

End of file — messy, will refine after internal review.
